column7: The ungated /secret-access-requests family authorized only through requireAdminAuthorityAt, which resolves roles without Authorize, so a project-confined PAT of a project admin could list and read secret access requests in every project and APPROVE them (200 before the fix); POST resolved its target through CheckSecretPermission, whose owner/share/ACL paths also skip Authorize (cross-project existence oracle). Fixed with requireAccessRequestAuthorityAt (roles.assign at the request's project first) and a PAT check at the top of CheckSecretPermission (the AuthorizeSecret PAT-SCOPE-002 check). Found by PAT-GUARD-1's family sweep
